old_problem: The active review exposed missing retimer topology and tool inputs but assumed the source's generic non-zero and zero-ErrCnt oracle could be parameterized. AMD release notes directly identify a PCIe retimer downstream-port margin zero-value issue and require stepthrough mode, so receiver-direction, tool-build and workaround semantics are core test authority rather than simple runtime values.
disposition_reason: The source names proprietary AMDXIO receiver values 2 and 3 but provides no approved build, receiver map, output schema or release-specific workaround. AMD documentation records a retimer DSPP margin zero-value defect whose prescribed AMDXIO method is stepthrough, and AMD errata also describes transient invalid zero margin status. ED-03 cannot fill in an OEM tool's command semantics; ED-15 forbids PASS without an authoritative value/error oracle, and ED-16/ED-17 require approved disruptive tooling, monitoring and recovery. Pending must remain until the project/AMD owner resolves these particulars.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row404 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2996 and both same-code row403/404 variants.
Preserved row404's distinct retimer upstream receiver=2 and downstream receiver=3 runs and did not substitute row403 endpoint receiver=6 coverage.
AMD release notes explicitly associate a zero margin result at the retimer DSPP with a required AMDXIO `-method=stepthrough` workaround; the source command omits it.
AMD Family 19h errata shows margin status can transiently read zero and requires invalid-zero reread handling, so an unconditional any-zero failure rule is unsafe without platform/build authority.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row405 and verified its manifest identity; no AMDXIO, margin or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Eight-path retimer upstream-receiver-2 and downstream-receiver-3 four-point margin characterization
test_case.purpose: Measure and independently validate every lane on both retimer channel segments for all eight AMD OAM paths using the approved direction-specific AMDXIO method, without confusing endpoint receiver coverage or invalid zero samples.
required_package: AMD-approved AMDXIO build/checksum/license/release notes and exact receiver=2/3 plus stepthrough syntax documentation
Eight current full-domain root-port/upstream-retimer/downstream-retimer/endpoint chains and physical lane maps
Authoritative mapping of receiver 2 to upstream segment and receiver 3 to downstream segment for the exact retimer/platform
Approved CSV schema, lane ordering, invalid-zero/re-read rules, four ErrCnt meanings and numeric PASS/FAIL thresholds
Isolated maintenance window, independent access, AER/link/GPU/thermal monitoring, abort and retimer/link recovery
test_case.test_command: NOT RELEASED FOR EXECUTION. Once AMD/project authority is supplied, attest each live retimer chain and baseline link/AER/GPU/thermal state, then run the signed build-specific four-point profile separately for receiver 2 and receiver 3 using the approved normal or stepthrough method. Preserve direction-tagged stdout/stderr and original CSVs, apply the approved invalid-zero/re-read and error-count rules, and verify link/retimer/GPU health after each path before proceeding.
test_case.expected_result: Both approved receiver directions complete for every mapped retimer path; each direction contains exactly the expected per-lane records; valid margin and four directional error-count fields satisfy the signed numeric and invalid-sample rules; no disallowed link/AER/GPU/thermal event occurs; and all paths remain at their required rate/width after testing.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PENDING AUTHORITY. PASS requires an approved AMDXIO build and method, exact receiver-direction mapping, complete lane/schema evidence, release-specific zero/re-read/stepthrough rules and numeric margin/error thresholds. A generic non-zero check, combined receiver output or endpoint receiver=6 result cannot pass.
safety_gate: Do not execute without signed AMDXIO provenance and build/platform-specific receiver and stepthrough guidance
Derive full-domain retimer chains live; never reuse source example BDF paths without attestation
Run receiver 2 and receiver 3 independently and preserve direction labels; never merge their results
Isolate one path at a time with independent management and live AER/link/GPU/thermal monitoring
Stop on mapping/schema ambiguity, retimer/link degradation, AER escalation, thermal event or failed recovery; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Approved AMDXIO binary/checksum/release guidance and receiver 2/3/stepthrough authority
Eight full-domain root/retimer/endpoint and physical-lane maps plus baseline health
Exact direction-tagged commands, complete stdout/stderr and original receiver 2 and receiver 3 CSVs
Per-lane parser output applying approved invalid-zero, reread, stepthrough, numeric margin and four-ErrCnt rules
Post-direction link/rate/AER/GPU/thermal comparison for every path
test_case.recovery: On receiver, schema, link or margin anomaly, stop the current and all remaining paths, preserve both direction datasets, use independent access to verify retimer and endpoint enumeration/link rate/AER/GPU health, perform only the AMD/project-approved recovery and escalate. Do not rerun or reinterpret zero results without the missing authority.
